title: Empirical-Grounding Filter at DECIDE (Tier-2 Methodology Vocabulary)
summary: At ADR-drafting time the dyad asks whether the commitment is empirically grounded by one of four paths (PLAY evidence; stakeholder-articulated demand; spike validation; structural operationalization); when none applies the ADR takes Conditional Acceptance or the adr-deferred- filename pattern. Two nested sub-decisions: Target 2 (the discriminating criterion is acknowledged, not resolved) and Target 3 (standalone at commitment time, in two senses). Tier-2; graduation trigger after 2–4 cycles.

links.note: Tier-2 application at ADR-drafting; the felt-trigger record in the ADR's Provenance check is the audit-bearing artifact
ADR-098 applies this filter reflexively to scope its own deferrals
ADR-099 takes Conditional Acceptance on paths 2 (stakeholder demand) and 3 (spike); path 4 (corpus-scale BUILD) is what transitions it to Accepted
ADR-100 takes Conditional Acceptance on path 2 with a named grounding action (targeted lit-review) for the Conditional period
Conditional Acceptance institutional pattern; transitioned to full acceptance at WP-H4 close 2026-05-12
